ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.title: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits
ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.summary: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits.

ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.title: Relates to winter road maintenance data collection and monitoring
ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.summary: Establishes a standardized statewide system for collecting, recording, and monitoring winter road maintenance operational data in order to improve efficiency, enhance transparency, and support the protection of water resources in the state of New York; requires calibration of all deicing material application equipment used for winter highway maintenance on public roads.

ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.title: Establishes the New York State grid reliability and energy affordability transition (GREAT) act
ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.summary: Establishes the New York State grid reliability and energy affordability transition (GREAT) act; establishes the virtual power plant program to help reduce energy costs and grid reliability risks; provides incentives to participants for supporting the grid by investing in distributed energy resources and reducing net energy costs.

ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.title: Relates to placing restrictions on the sale of flare guns
ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.summary: Establishes the crimes of criminal sale of a flare gun in the first and second degrees; sets restrictions on and requirements for the sale of flare guns.

ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.title: Requires certain construction project contracts to include siting of renewable energy systems, qualified energy storage systems, or electric major utility transmission facilities
ny-sd-25/jabari-brisport.summary: Requires certain construction project contracts with a value of greater than or equal to five million dollars to include siting of renewable energy systems, qualified energy storage systems, or major electric transmission facilities.
